title: Dream Sheep
description: this mod gives sheep a new dimension and love
body:
WARNING:This mod requires neoforge 21.4.137 specifically

Dream ore:a new ore now spawns in the overworld that can drop dream gems

dream gem:dream gems can be crafted into tools and armor

dream armor:more stronger than netherite armor

dream trophy blocks:can crafted with 9 dream gems and can be used to build a portal

dream sheep:a new mob that can spawn in any biome and when killed drops igniter pieces that can be crafted into a igniter(will not try to attack you) 

dream dimension:a new dimmension that has new trees and new wood (includes
planks fences...

Floaters:new mobs that can fly and spawn in the dream dimension(will try to attack you)

Floater aura:just right click the ground and you will levitate

Th3 N1ghtMar3:new mob that when killed drops the nightmare orb when used you will fall into a nightmare

hope you enjoy this mod☺
